scope: Repository review and isolated regression only; no production startup, network acquisition, real-user trial or browser control.

package.limitation: File integrity and selected code hashes verified; not independent launch/Python 3.11/full-stack/secret-content certification.

reported_not_independently_accepted: Four real companies passed a manually transcribed CSV path; not the in-app adapter acquisition path or a full original-document audit.
Browser watch-note version conflict has follow-up evidence; keyboard/native upload/download/real narrow viewport remain unverified.
Reports say archive hygiene and isolated startup/restart/rollback succeeded; full-stack launcher and Python 3.11 are unverified.

source_findings.finding: Research materials are only shown as task count; no frontend fact selection or research-collect call. A3 report confirms UI workflow absent.

Adapter has raw response text, but collection persists normalized rows, URLs and retrieval timestamp, not a raw response snapshot/hash reference. Old notice date is still used as availability for current returned values; synthetic restatement test alone does not prove historical PIT.

UI still says missing currency defaults CNY and all evidence links are official; research label checks research_material but producer emits user_provided. Current origin labels are not consistently evidence-driven.

409 conflict refreshes watchlist; preserve the unsaved local note separately rather than losing input. Report confirms refresh resets conditions without warning and current cancel means request disconnect, not server cancel.
Release-gate header points to intermediate archive although final archive supersedes it. Grouped unverified counts and source-check pass claims should be replaced by per-test/channel/build evidence.

validation_note: New probe first run failed only during temporary SQLite cleanup because the harness connection remained open; corrected harness to explicitly close the connection and reran successfully. No product code was edited.
